scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install && npm run sync:frontend
scripts.sync:frontend: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('backend/public')) fs.mkdirSync('backend/public', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend', 'backend/public', {recursive:true}); console.log('✅ Frontend synchronized to backend/public');"
